content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family and attached homes to first-time and move-up buyers, with mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Sells finished lots to homebuilders (B2B) rather than building and selling homes to individual buyers."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual Sunbelt buyers, with in-house mortgage financing."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family and attached homes to first-time and move-up buyers, with mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family homes to first-time and move-up buyers, with mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family and townhomes to homebuyers, with affiliated mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Insurance underwriter for title, mortgage guaranty and commercial lines; it does not build or sell homes."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Life insurer with mortgage lending and cemetery businesses; it does not build or sell homes."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family and attached homes to first-time, move-up and active adult buyers, with mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Diversified landowner running hotels, clubs, restaurants and timber; its lot and home sales are a minor part of a different mix."}]}
